term: C as the sum total of contingent things (A1)
definition: The site introduces C as the sum total of all contingent things. The mere definition does not establish that C is itself contingent, is a single thing in the relevant ontology, has parts in the required sense, or can bear a causal relation. Those are additional premises and interpretation questions.
